race.title: BetMGM Haldon Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Grade 2) (Limited Handicap) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Successful in a Grade 1 novice here in April, MIRABAD made an encouraging return over hurdles when second in a listed race at Carlisle and he could still have more to offer as a chaser. He gets the vote ahead of JPR One , who showed that he retains all of his enthusiasm when defying top weight in a Cheltenham handicap on his reappearance, with Brookie also considered. MIRABAD (FR) JPR ONE (IRE) BROOKIE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Mirabad (5/4), JPR One (3/1), Rubaud (6/1), Stencil (8/1), Brookie (8/1), Daytime Dreaming (14/1)
